title: Your First Weekend at Dickinson College, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Unpack and Meet Your Floor
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Morning Move-In
cards.notes: Start your journey by moving into your residence hall. Meet your Resident Advisor and neighbors during the first floor meeting at 2:00 PM to kick off orientation.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the first-year experience begins with residential move-in and floor meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Move-in occurs from 8-11 AM on Wednesday, followed by a First Floor Meeting in Residence Halls from 2-3 PM.
cards.source_title: Move-In and Orientation Schedule - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residential students and their families during move-in hours.

cards.title: Grab Info and Swag
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Information Tents
cards.notes: Head to the center of campus to visit information tents. It is the best spot to ask questions and get your bearings before the formal ceremonies begin.
cards.short_summary: Britton Plaza serves as the central hub for information and campus navigation during orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: All college information tents are located at Britton Plaza from 10 AM to 12 PM on the first day of orientation.
cards.source_title: Move-In and Orientation Schedule - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Open public plaza in the heart of campus.

cards.title: Join the Welcome Night
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Evening Social
cards.notes: Gather on the grass for Welcome Night. This large-scale social event is designed for the entire incoming class to mingle and celebrate their arrival.
cards.short_summary: Morgan Field hosts the primary evening social event for new students on their first night.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Night is held on Morgan Field from 7-9 PM on the first Wednesday of orientation.
cards.source_title: Move-In and Orientation Schedule - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor field accessible to all students.

cards.title: Attend the Hype Session
cards.subtitle: Thursday Morning Kickoff
cards.notes: Start your second day with high energy at the ATS. This session transitions you from social move-in to the academic expectations of the college.
cards.short_summary: The ATS auditorium is the venue for large-scale student assemblies and orientation hype sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: A Welcome/Hype Session is scheduled at ATS from 8:30-9:30 AM on the Thursday of orientation week.
cards.source_title: Move-In and Orientation Schedule - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Indoor auditorium used for major campus events.

cards.title: Sign Into the College
cards.subtitle: Sunday Convocation Tradition
cards.notes: Walk up the historic stone steps of Old West to sign the college ledger. This tradition officially marks your entry into the Dickinson community.
cards.short_summary: The 'Signing In' ceremony at Old West is a foundational tradition for every new Dickinson student.
cards.evidence_claim: During Convocation, new students walk up the stone steps of Old West and sign into the college in Memorial Hall.
cards.source_title: Dickinson Officially Welcomes the Class of 2029 at Convocation
cards.access_notes: The doors of Old West are opened specifically for this ceremony.

cards.title: Share a Welcome Meal
cards.subtitle: Daily Orientation Dining
cards.notes: Head to 'The Caf' for a meal with your New Student Guide. It is the primary spot to refuel and meet classmates between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: The main dining hall in the HUB is the central location for orientation meals and student gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Lunch and 'Meet and Eat' sessions with New Student Guides are held at the Dining Hall.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operations and Highlights | Dining Hall - Dickinson College
cards.access_notes: Requires a meal swipe or payment for entry.

cards.title: Explore Your Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Academic Resource Tour
cards.notes: Visit the library to learn about research resources. It's open late on Sundays, making it a key spot for preparing for your first Monday classes.
cards.short_summary: Waidner-Spahr Library provides critical academic support and late-night study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is open until 12 AM on Sundays during the academic semester.
cards.access_notes: Dickinson ID required after 5 PM for entry.

cards.title: Active Break at Kline
cards.subtitle: Weekend Recreation
cards.notes: Take a break from orientation meetings with a workout. The fitness center offers weekend hours for students to stay active before classes start.
cards.short_summary: The Kline Center is the primary facility for student fitness, recreation, and intramural sports.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kline Fitness Center is open on Saturdays from 9 AM - 7 PM and Sundays from 12 PM - 10:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students with a valid Dickinson ID.

cards.title: Coffee at The Quarry
cards.subtitle: Weekend Social Hangout
cards.notes: Visit this reimagined campus hangout for a locally roasted coffee. It is a favorite spot for students to socialize in a relaxed, historic setting.
cards.short_summary: The Quarry is a central campus social space featuring Denim Coffee and student meeting areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Denim Coffee at the Quarry is open seven days a week from 7:30 AM to 3 PM.
cards.source_title: Dickinson Welcomes Denim Coffee at the Quarry
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and students daily.

cards.title: Movie Night Downtown
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Out
cards.notes: Walk a few blocks into downtown Carlisle for a movie. The college often partners with this historic theatre for free student screenings during opening week.
cards.short_summary: The Carlisle Theatre is a historic venue downtown that hosts community and student film events.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation events have included free screenings for students at the Carlisle Theatre (40 W. High St).
cards.access_notes: Located downtown; specific orientation screenings are free for students.
